# Tiptoe model attribution

- Title: **Tiptoe**
- Author: **GT** (`Cooldude16` on Sketchfab)
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/tiptoe-a541402dc909453ba80d3954f0efeb2b
- License: **CC BY 4.0** — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The original rig, materials, textures, skin, and `GorillaTag_IK_RigV3.001Action` animation are preserved in `tiptoe.glb`. The Unity prefab adds gameplay navigation, perception, collision, and uniform visual-height normalization without flattening the animated model.
